name: Closed-book LLM
desc: One model call, no tools. The control group: shows what a model alone believes is current.

name: ReAct (hand-rolled)
desc: Classic Thought/Action/Observation loop parsed from plain text; up to 5 searches.

name: OpenAI SDK tool-caller
desc: Native function calling with tavily_search + tavily_extract tools, up to 6 turns, retries on 5xx.
